description: Update the policy binding system to properly support nullable binding objects. Currently, some API endpoints and client models incorrectly require non-null values for binding objects, which prevents proper handling of unbound policies. This fix will ensure consistency across all API endpoints and client SDKs.
functional_requirements: Update the policy binding API endpoints to accept null values for binding objects when policies are not bound to specific resources
Modify all client SDK models (Go, Rust, TypeScript) to properly serialize/deserialize nullable binding objects
Update the web interface's bound policies list to handle cases where binding objects may be null
